notes.title: Hot Slice – New Update Available!
notes.notes:
Hello! 🎮 
We’re excited to bring you the latest update that addresses some important fixes and improvements! 💡

First, we’ve fixed the issue where the character (round gear) was spilling outside the screen. Now, everything stays neatly within the boundaries! 🔒 We’ve also added visible gray borders to make these boundaries clearer, so you’ll always know exactly where your game world ends. 🖥️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270866/a97f5625a335024049b4b83f879c93845f766c58.gif[/img]

But that’s not all! 😎 We’ve also introduced zoom functionality, so now when you resize the game window, the game will automatically zoom in or out, allowing you to scale the game to your preferred resolution with ease. 🌐 Whether you like playing at a larger scale or prefer a more compact view, you can now adjust it to fit your needs! 📏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270866/9ce2f4858f670c0cb5f430e68d8f16dabd08719a.gif[/img]

This update is all about improving your gaming experience, and we can’t wait to hear what you think! 🗣️ Let us know your feedback in the comments and enjoy the new features! 🎉

Happy gaming, and see you in the game! 🚀

notes.title: Hot Slice: Lust Exposed Launches Tomorrow!
